// Package respond may import os/exec because it carries out responses the user
// confirmed. It may not make network calls.
package respond

import (
	"context"
	"net/http" // want: depguard
	"os/exec"
)

// Method keeps the net/http import in use.
const Method = http.MethodPost

// Command uses os/exec where it is allowed.
func Command(ctx context.Context) *exec.Cmd {
	return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "true")
}
